verdict.rationale: Nitrokey documents an OpenPGP smart card function with on-device key generation. Its OpenPGP-card docs include a Thunderbird section, which covers the encrypted-email part of the story. Nothing in the pack mentions git commit signing, and the docs evidence is mostly section headings. missing for 10: documented git commit signing workflow, in-depth OpenPGP email setup detail, independent hands-on corroboration of OpenPGP use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep OpenPGP keys on the device and use them for git commit signing and encrypted email
